item.g:title: 100 Assorted Self Adhesive Gift Labels
item.g:description: Add the perfect finishing touch to your presents with this bumper pack of 100 Self Adhesive Gift Labels. Featuring a mix of foiled and novelty designs, each label brings seasonal charm with phrases like “Merry & Bright” and cheerful characters including Santa, snowmen, and reindeer. With gold, silver, and colourful styles to choose from, these easy-to-use stickers make gift-giving even more joyful and hassle-free.

item.g:title: 100 Foil Paper Chains
item.g:description: Add instant sparkle to your festive décor with this pack of 100 foil paper chains in shimmering gold, silver, red, and green. The durable foil finish catches the light beautifully, making these chains a standout choice for quick, colourful decorating across multiple spaces. Ideal for Christmas, parties, classrooms, and seasonal displays, each pre-cut strip is easy to loop and link.

item.g:title: 100 Poems to Help You Relax
item.g:description: If you’ve been searching for something that brings a moment of quiet into busy or difficult days, this hardback collection of poems offers a gentle pause. Each page holds thoughtful lines from poets such as W. B. Yeats, Robert Burns, Mary Oliver and more, creating pockets of comfort, distraction and steady breathing.

item.g:title: 15 Minute Art: Drawing
item.g:description: This inspiring drawing guide offers 50 quick projects that make drawing feel playful, relaxing and wonderfully accessible. Using simple coloured pencils and markers, you’ll explore flowers, fruit, patterns, characters and more, with each project broken down into no more than six steps. Perfect for bringing a moment of focus and calm during the challenges of cancer treatment, or simply as a delightful everyday gift for someone who loves to create.

item.g:title: 15 Minute Art: Painting
item.g:description: Discover the pleasure of painting with fifty quick, nature‑themed projects designed to be completed in just 15 minutes. With simple steps, colour guidance and space to practise, you can enjoy art without stress or pressure. The book offers a quick overview of how to sketch your artwork, along with traceable templates that make it easy to dive straight into the pleasure of painting. Perfect for bringing a moment of focus and calm during the challenges of cancer treatment, or simply as a delightful everyday gift for someone who loves to create.

item.g:title: 15 Minute Art: Watercolour
item.g:description: Dip into 50 quick, nature‑inspired watercolour projects—from fruit and florals to fish, animals and patterns. Each one takes six steps or fewer and comes with practice pages, colour guides and tips. With traceable templates for all designs, the blank page becomes far less daunting. Perfect for bringing a moment of focus and calm during the challenges of cancer treatment, or simply as a delightful everyday gift for someone who loves to create.

item.g:title: Breathe by Jean Hall
item.g:description: Breathing properly is one of the simplest ways to increase your energy, improve your sleep and reduce stress. Moreover, you can practise alone, and it's free. Drawing on the practices of yoga, meditation and mindfulness, this book provides clear, step-by-step instructions for 20 exercises to improve the way you breathe. Learn the essentials such as moving breath, mindful breathing and how to rebalance the breath, and open yourself up to feelings of renewed energy. Breathe : simple breathing techniques for a calmer, happier life by Jean Hall, ISBN: 9781837830718, Hardback, 19 x 14 x 2cm, 378g, 142 pages, Quadrille Publishing, 2024,

item.g:title: Cancer Research UK Post-Surgery Comfort Bra - S / Black / VAT Exempt
item.g:description: Introducing the Cancer Research UK Post-Surgery Comfort Bra: a bra developed by us with breast cancer patients every step of the way. Suitable for use after a mastectomy, lumpectomy, lymph node removal, or breast reconstruction. A lined pocket with removable pads also provides space to add a prothesis, if desired. It's also designed to be comfortable for everyday wear for non-patients, too. Soft, seamless, breathable bambooMade from a super soft, knitted fabric with a tubular, seamless design, the bra offers the ultimate in comfort and support. The wide, fully adjustable straps and front hook and eye fastenings ensure a perfect fit. The main fabric is derived from natural bamboo that's soft against sensitive skin, as well as being breathable, moisture wicking, and antibacterial. Ideal for all day and long-term wear. FitWe recommend your normal dress size for a comfortable fit. If you’re an E cup or above, going up one size will provide added ease and gentle support. Find out more by watching our video guide to adjusting the bra for your body. This bra funds researchOver the last 40 years, Cancer Research UK's work has helped double breast cancer survival. Every sale of this bra ensures that progress continues, with 100% of net profits funding future breast cancer research projects. 4 colour and 6 size options, Wide shoulder straps, Hook and eye fastening at centre front, with 3 adjustable settings, 100% net profits are donated directly to our breast cancer research projects,

Suitable for use after a mastectomy, lumpectomy, lymph node removal, or breast reconstruction. A lined pocket with removable pads also provides space to add a prothesis, if desired. It's also designed to be comfortable for everyday wear for non-patients, too. Soft, seamless, breathable bambooMade from a super soft, knitted fabric with a tubular, seamless design, the bra offers the ultimate in comfort and support. The wide, fully adjustable straps and front hook and eye fastenings ensure a perfect fit. The main fabric is derived from natural bamboo that's soft against sensitive skin, as well as being breathable, moisture wicking, and antibacterial. Ideal for all day and long-term wear. FitWe recommend your normal dress size for a comfortable fit. If you’re an E cup or above, going up one size will provide added ease and gentle support. Find out more by watching our video guide to adjusting the bra for your body. This bra funds researchOver the last 40 years, Cancer Research UK's work has helped double breast cancer survival. Every sale of this bra ensures that progress continues, with 100% of net profits funding future breast cancer research projects. 4 colour and 6 size options, Wide shoulder straps, Hook and eye fastening at centre front, with 3 adjustable settings, 100% net profits are donated directly to our breast cancer research projects,

item.g:title: Royce Silver Post Surgery Bra - 32B/C / VAT Exempt
item.g:description: This post-surgery bra by Royce is an anti-bacterial, super-soft, breathable bra designed for use after any type of breast or chest surgery. It has been developed from anti-bacterial, anti-odour, thermo-regulating X-STATIC silver fibre to aid the healing process and allow safe wearing immediately after surgery. Built for comfort and support, it's crop top design features seam-free detail to steer irritation and a deep underbust for an optimum, secure fit. Popper, front and cushioned fastenings allow easy accessibility and touch-and-close adjustable shoulder straps maintain comfort. Double layer cups feature a pocketed area for softies if needed. Features: Easy to open and close front-fastening, Anti-bacterial and anti-odour, 100% natural, Thermo-regulating, Permanent - will not wash or wear out,
